items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: who did we do that recording with, Dave Remembers? Walter Cronkite. ... Cronkite is talking about the Bulge, his memory of it, with me.

ctx.x: Yeah, I’ve seen the book. Yes. It’s about the Battle of the Bulge.
And the Bulge has a good story with – that’s how it was – who did we do that recording with, Dave Remembers? Walter Cronkite.
